authorization_status: engineering diagnosis only; series-level readings do not enter any authorization ledger, no TRY was written, no Skill was compiled, no authorization artifact was modified

frozen_inputs.geometry_census_row_unit: cohort x task_episode_id x train series uid at observation_cutoff = support_origins[0]

geometry_census_provenance.expansion: runtime.public_features._expand (radius=2, the same helper the union uses)
geometry_census_provenance.roster_reconstruction: rosters come from the existing agentic.runner.load_cohort. any sealed Outcome (NOAA, g3_final_query_outcome, delayed truth)
any Weather Utility or gain symbol (METRIC_UNREADABLE)

preregistration.scope_class_rule: all series in a probe's scope share one mask_class -> that class; otherwise MIXED_SCOPE.  Frozen before these numbers were computed and not adjusted after.
preregistration.degeneracy_exit: if the scope class never varies, report SCOPE_CLASS_DEGENERATE and stop; that is a dumb result, not a negative one
questions: does level-repair utility sign split by the geometry of the scope?
does the outlier family concentrate positive on outlier geometry?
any program x scope-class cell with >= 3 distinct positive Tasks and 0 opposing (mechanism precheck, explicitly not authorization)?
preregistration.post_hoc_marker: the outlier-dominance split and the correlations are post-hoc, diagnosis-only, and are labelled as such; they are not a substitute pre-registered variable

only_train_keyed_per_series_block_in_any.reading: the one per-series block keyed on train series is a substrate preflight (floor-hit / clean flags), not a utility reading

verdict.reading: The pre-registered scope-class variable is constant (MIXED) on every series any probe ever acted on, in every cohort, so the geometry recut cannot separate anything.  Independently, per-series utility is measured only on eval series while geometry is labelled only on train series, and the two uid sets are disjoint, so a true per-series response x geometry join does not exist in the paid traces.  This is the pre-declared degeneracy exit: a dumb result, not a negative one.

confound_check_scope_geometry_vs_task_in.why: the scope grows and the region fractions drift monotonically as the observation cutoff advances, so any gain-vs-geometry correlation in this cohort is confounded with the Task's position in the roster
